field_text_formatted.value: It builds on JSON:API Node Preview, which serves the unsaved node as a JSON:API document. That module is still in beta, so this release is a candidate. For unsaved paragraphs, also apply the patch from #3367724 with cweagans/composer-patches, as the example site's composer.json does.
